t:
Yes, the dragon is a big deal! Dragons are… so impressive!

You probably already know that the world teemed with dragons in ancient times. The most terrible of all were the Great Dragons - Guardian Dragons - but even small things caused a lot of problems.

They killed everyone indiscriminately - the Kanians, the Xadaganians, the Orcs, and the Gibberlings - they killed without mercy, spitting fire and tearing into flesh.

So when the Great Mages came into power, they launched a hunt for the remaining dragons. They paid the hunters that brought them the corpses of these winged creatures. Why do mages need dragon carcasses? No idea! That's their great secret.

So they gradually wiped them out. By the beginning of the Allods era, there were very few dragons left, mostly in remote places. And eventually they just... vanished.

The last Dragon Hunter was a certain Harat. He knew where the last of them were and where they secretly produced offspring. He tracked them down, then sold the eggs to the Free Traders. And those managed to raise the young.

There was one problem - dragons do not grow in captivity. They don't get much bigger than a horse. But even those creatures are still in demand. While there is little magical power in them, they nonetheless have it...

Lions are essentially cats, just with a mane. And with a mane, everyone will look more imposing.

In ancient times, these lions lived somewhere in the steppes... Yes, lions normally don't live in jungles and forests. Remember that.

However, the heroes of our story were lucky enough to fall into the hands of the Elves who fought the Battle for Beauty which in fact was a series of extermination campaigns throughout Yul.

And the Elves appreciated the beauty of lions - they considered them an almost ideal predator. I'd say a tiger or a bear, especially a white one, is more impressive. But, as you understand, the Elves did not ask for my opinion.

They caught a couple of dozen lion cubs and brought them to Irene, a kingdom in the northwestern forests. They started breeding and crossing those cats. That's how riding lions came to be, although it wasn't easy.

So it's believed that the lion is an elven beast, although they are widely sold by the Free Traders now.

Everyone who heard about it probably thought it was a joke.

A riding fish? That flies?

The things the Great Mages come up with...! But yes, that wonder is real.

The Great Mages are what? Immortal! Right. They live long and rarely die. Everything can get boring when you live a long life.

So they come up with all sorts of wonders, bringing fables to life. "Enchanted fish that fly and breathe air?

Ambitious but doable," the wizards probably said, taking out their magic wands.

Therefore, when you see a fish hovering above the ground, don't be surprised. Remember: nothing is impossible!

The Gryphons are proud birds. It's like a combination of two royal creatures, a lion and an eagle. In the old era, they were almost everywhere, so they became one of the main types of transport for all kinds of nobility. There was no castle without a Gryphon in a special stable, and the imperial service of messengers also flew on Gryphons. And many coats of arms depicted them, too... There was even a clan - the Gryphon's Heart... Ah, I'll tell you about it some other time, let's stick to the point!

Attempts were made to improve them in every possible way, and all sorts of new species were bred. And then a Great Mage came up with something indescribable. He crossed a Gryphon and a mare - and created a Hippogriff! But in the wild, horses and Gryphons can't stand each other!

But as you understand, all this Gryphon abundance couldn't last forever. The world cracked in half, the rift began to boil - the Allods era began. And the Gryphons, which could fly long distances, immediately became unnecessary. No, they can still be useful but, as you understand, it's not the same these days...

Oh, the Xadaganian horse... You must have heard from me that the most convenient way to travel in the desert is by camel. But the desert is one thing, but the steppe and forest are quite another. Nezeb also understood this, and when he was preparing to conquer Kania, he ordered his servants to buy horses and breed new ones. It was where Igsh is now, the very border between the desert and the steppe.

Well, the people of Ugra also dealt with horses, so they quickly realized what it was all about. Instead of the huge heroic Kanian horses, they created a light and undemanding horse. It was very fast, perfect for sudden attacks.

Simply put, if it hadn't been for this horse, Xadagan wouldn't exist at all.
r194608.n: Ask about the mount: Xadaganian Steed

t:
Oh, what a marvel, a flying board.

Another invention of wise engineers! I don’t know who invented them, either Dr. Burov with his assistant Motya, or Catherina herself...

There are so many modifications these days...

And some genius took parts from the Lightning Bolt and attached them to this board, so now it can shoot! Just imagine!

 I know many people like to race on these boards. Here at the Winter Resort, for example. Those who don't care for sleds can try to slide down the mountain on a board. What is it called? A snowboard, huh?

The Waterfolk and Aviaks on the Summer Atoll came up with even better ideas. They attached a sail to the board and started racing on the water, catching the wind. Amazing!

Hyena. Hmm, that animal is strange. It's neither a dog nor a cat, but sort of like its own thing. They live in the Izune steppes, and for some reason the Orcs are very fond of them.

Perhaps because they laugh, and the Orcs love to have fun. Anyway, the Orcs tamed hyenas and now use them as pets.

However, there are also special types of hyenas that are much bigger. So the Orcs decided to put a saddle on them... Why? The hyena is a smart animal, It can track down an enemy... So the hyenas became not only faithful "dogs", but also "horses" for the Orcs.

Lemurs are inhabitants of tropical islands where the Aviaks live. These creatures are intelligent enough to have their own ruler - imagine that! And their prince is now Juju, quite an interesting individual. I could talk for hours about his adventures with a gang of penguins from Isa, but that's a story for another day. The important thing now is that Juju can only be found on the tropical atoll. And only in July, during the Summer Flame Festival!
r194614.n: Lemurs are inhabitants of tropical islands where the Aviaks live.…

t:
A motorcycle?

Another invention that will doom us all!

I heard they call it an iron horse, and I thought: what if the world turns into something that's entirely made of metal in a couple of centuries?

We will live in cities where houses are built with man-made stone, and there will be magic lamps all around, the kind the Elves have.

And these iron horses will run around these cities, roaring and howling?

A nightmare, if you think about it.

Well, it's a funny invention, an attempt to make a combat mechanism more popular among the masses by stripping it of most weapons and leaving only speed. And it worked: soon many people decided to get one for themselves and customized it. Mostly in the Empire, but the League also showed some interest.
r194619.n: A motorcycle? Another invention that will doom us all! I heard they…

t:
An ogre?

Well, riding an ogre is almost the same as riding a crocodile. As long as it's full, it's safe. But once it gets hungry...

However, there are brave men who like a challenge: I'm talking about Demon Hunters, of course.

They were the first to breed ogres, so you have probably seen them during the war with the Architects.

And it seemed to make sense: the ogre is hardy and strong, and can carry a whole turret with the shooter.

After the war on Dane, they quickly put them into service, especially in the Imperial army where the ogres had been used before.

Of course, they didn’t give them an actual weapon, but even a stun gun worked well.

I know there are attempts to bring in trolls and Draconids, but so far the attempts have floundered.

Uh, crayfish? It has to be some kind of joke.

However, people ride all kinds of things now - why not ride crayfish? I remember a story about one distant island where people were very fond of sayings and proverbs, and there was a mountain with a sanctuary on it.

And in that sanctuary Cra'ay was worshiped. It was considered a great piece of luck if he started whistling, and it almost never happened.

Maybe that's where the idea was born that you should ride a giant crayfish on a Fool's Day? And Fool's Day is a holiday when it's customary to do things topsy-turvy. That's why jokers and pranksters decided it would be great if proud and brave warriors were sitting astride a crayfish that day.

They took one of these - red as though cooked - and cast a few spells. You cast a spell, and your horse turns into an illusion, looking exactly like that crayfish.

And if you have a sense of humor and don't mind riding an actual crayfish, you can go and buy one from the Holiday Committee Officials.

The rhinoceros is power. While the Stomper is a rare beast, rhinos are everywhere. They are fond of the steppes but wander to other lands as well.

It is said that in ancient times there lived Indrik the Beast, the father of all animals.

And many believe that it was a huge rhino, and not a unicorn or a Stomper.

This creature that weighs several tens of pounds is not just a vehicle - it's a weapon as it is. Apparently, that's why the Orcs love it so much, and if you've ever been to the Wild Isles, then you've had the opportunity to see that rhinos are the basis of their economy.

Now there are many different types of rhinos, to fit any taste.

Oh, what a miracle! Both a horse and a bird.

How does the song go? “And fly into the wild blue yonder On the wings of a slender flying horse". It's also believed that Pegasi can create a spring by striking the ground with their hooves. It gives powers of creativity to those who drink from it... But it's most likely fiction.

As for the rest, what can I say? One of the oldest mounts, a kind of classic that has gained popularity again. Bred by sorcerers in the old era and beloved by the Aoidoi.

By some twist of fate, a small herd of Pegasi settled on Ammer. Soon a new breed was created.

So if you happen to visit Ammer, you can see them there.
r194624.n: Oh, what a miracle! Both a horse and a bird. How does the song go?…

t:
Rabbits and hares.

Oh. Well, that doesn't sound serious.

However, there are a lot of funny things in our life, which is quite important. So the idea of a mount that could move over rough terrain appealed to many.  In this regard, hares are no worse than other, less "cute" little animals.

And a huge hare, about two meters tall, can give you a kick you will remember for a while. But riding hares, however, are civilized animals - they are trained to do other things. To inspire others to fight, they beat the drums.

We don't know who was the first to take the hares into service. I think it was the Gibberlings - they tame all sorts of little animals. I know for sure that the elves of the House de Ardeur decided to improve the hares. Either they feed them something, or they put some kind of implants in their legs, but their hares jump higher than the roofs. Hare races are held in Irene.

Snakes or worms, collectively known as crawlers, are also amazing creatures. They are united, as you understand, by the way they move - on their bellies. As far as I know, wise magicians categorize them somehow, but to me it makes no difference whatsoever.

These incredible creatures once lived inside mountains or in the depths of the oceans, but the Cataclysm changed everything - it brought them to the brink of extinction. These worms and snakes can be found only in the most remote corners of the world.

The first to find worms were the Imperials who decided to use them for tunneling. For these purposes, a separate laboratory was created. However, it soon turned out that these creatures were not easy to control. A number of incidents confirmed that.

It was a little easier with sea snakes - finding these creatures was even more difficult, but taming them was easier. Soon the Free Traders started selling them everywhere.
r194629.n: Ask about the mount: Viper / Worm

t:
You've heard of the bear before. And what kind of animal is the Ice Bear, you ask?

It's very simple - it's a polar bear, once an inhabitant of the polar regions. Now you can find these bears on the Frozen Frontier, Coldberg, or Ferris.

Unlike the brown Bear, this beast is wilder and more distrustful of people. However, it wasn't a problem for the Empire. They found a small population on one of the cold allods, and among them was a very friendly bear cub. They named him Umka.

Since then, the Ice Bears have become part of the Xadaganian armed forces. They are skilled swimmers and can easily move through snow and ice, so they were made the basis of the medical service of the Empire.
r194633.n: Ask about the mount: Ice Bear

t:
There are wolves and there are Grimwolves!

What's the difference? The size. There was once a fool in a distant kingdom - Ivan Snegov. He didn’t know anything at all - absolutely nothing. Everyone told him that.

And then Ivan met a wonderful Grimwolf who started helping him with everything. If you needed to save some princess or queen, you could rely on the faithful Grimwolf in everything. And it turned out that Ivan was not a fool at all - on the contrary, he was a lost prince.

Since then, Grimwolves appear here and there, helping people. Some of them are even trained to speak. Or maybe they all know how to speak - they just have no reason to do so.

Now wolves are the second most popular mount after a horse, and the reason is simple - besides a remarkable mind, they also have teeth: they can bite an enemy, and that’s that.
r194634.n: There are wolves and there are Grimwolves! What's the difference? The…

t:
So you're interested in an archaeological exhibit.

The point is, Destree went extinct almost a thousand years ago. It was a horse that was bred in the old Kanian Empire when knights rode huge horses that could lift the weight of their armor.

That was a completely different era when it wasn't just the League and the Empire on Sarnaut, but a dozen other different kingdoms. The nobility participated in tournaments, and powerful horses cost insane amounts of money. But when the world broke up into allods, all this splendor came to an end.

However, I heard that it's very rare to find undead horses that belonged to those warriors.

Monolith Assault Shell is the latest prototype that allows you to expand your capabilities in battle. This unique mechanism is capable of protecting both the wearer and their allies, making them formidable adversaries! A character wearing an Assault Shell does not take fall damage and has increased movement speed. In addition, the Monolith has several unique abilities of its own!

The Monolith was designed using the blueprints and schematics found on the lost Ferris allod. This allod was a real treasure trove of old inventions of the Empire.
r194638.n: Ask about the combat mechanism: Assault ShellAssault Shell "Monolith"

t:
The Vanguard Assault Shell is the pinnacle of engineering. It provides its operator with reliable protection and additional capabilities in battle. This technology was created by Catherina's engineers based on the designs of the Zem people who had achieved significant progress in the field of prosthetics. Using magic reactors similar to those used in Clockwork Knights, the engineers from Glimor created unique "second arms".

Each Vanguard Assault Shell comes with the White Flame costume which includes a headwear, a back piece, and armor. The costume looks great with the Assault Shell. However, the Vanguard Assault Shell and White Flame costume can be equipped separately.
r194639.n: Ask about the combat mechanism: Assault ShellVanguard Assault Shell

t:
Another creation of Catherina's engineers. Using the blueprints of the Monolith and Vanguard as a base, they tried to combine their strengths. The result is the Escalade shell.

Even more powerful, it grants its wearer additional abilities.

Each Escalade Assault Shell comes with the Cold Synthesis costume which includes a headpiece and overalls. The costume looks great with the Assault Shell. However, the Escalade Assault Shell and Cold Synthesis costume can be equipped separately. In addition, when using the Blaze color pattern, you can also get the Energy Flow costume which is similar to the Cold Synthesis costume.
r194640.n: Ask about the combat mechanism: Assault ShellEscalade Assault Shell

t: This mystical armor was created by the Aoidoi who met our world's heroes armed with the latest technology. The Aoidoi were quick to appreciate all that had been achieved in recent times, and after seeing the combat armor, they offered their solution. With the help of Dominus Ionas, they forged new armor and handed it over to the representatives of the League and the Empire.
r194642.n: This mystical armor was created by the Aoidoi who met our world's…

t: An attempt by the Kanian engineers to combine combat armor and another variation of the Titan mount. Although the result is very bulky, the combat power of the resulting armor is astonishing. Based on the latest inventions in the field of mana engineering, this armor protects its wearer from any external threat.
r194645.n: An attempt by the Kanian engineers to combine combat armor and another…

t: Another experiment of the Demonologists. This time, the leaders of the order decided to cross the most powerful demons with their adepts in the form of succubi. The result of this unholy act was the Devourer armor which is essentially a living being that exists in symbiosis with its owner.
r194646.n: Another experiment of the Demonologists. This time, the leaders of the…

t: The blueprints for this armor were stolen from the Master's Citadel, otherwise known as Nihaz's Citadel. The heroes infiltrated the structure, connected to the terminals, and decrypted the data which was then sent to the best inventors among the Free Traders. So now the heroes of Sarnaut are armed with the technologies of Nihaz himself.
r194647.n: Ask about the combat mechanism: Assault ShellOverlord Assault Shell

t: This shell was created by the Great Mages of the Conclave who used the knowledge found in other worlds. Contains a particle of divine power. The information about other worlds and the subsequent calculations allowed us to learn a lot about the divine energies that exist outside of Sarnaut. Part of these energies are the forces of Destruction, Light, and Death. Nihaz's Citadel contained information on how to accumulate and concentrate divine energies. The Great Mages followed these instructions and created artifacts containing grains of such power, and then created a new armor equipped with them.
r194648.n: Ask about the combat mechanism: Mystic ShellDragon Cover Mystic Shell

t:
A mysterious artifact discovered in the woods of Eden. If you touch it, you can feel the Ambrosia pulsing inside. As it turned out, this armor is filled with the energy of Life itself.

Using the powers acquired in Eden, the engineers were able to create their own magical device that will serve any owner.
r194651.n: A mysterious artifact discovered in the woods of Eden. If you touch…

t: These shells are not from our world. Members of the Order of Progress, who delivered supplies to Catherina, got lost on the Star Trail once. They came upon traces of battle and found a few artifacts in various states of preservation. It turned out that these combat mechanisms belonged to the gods of other worlds who fought among themselves. Catherina's apprentices were eventually able to adapt this armor to our needs.
r194652.n: Ask about the combat mechanism: Mystic ShellDiv

Great! Now nothing is preventing you from being happy together!

Come back when you are ready for a serious relationship!
Well, you had enough time to change your mind. But as far as I can see, you are not going to fall back.

t:
Do you want to trade Crystals for gold, or vice versa? I can arrange everything in fine fashion!
Exchange rate is calculated based on the amount of Crystals I currently have. Everything is fare and square - as soon as the rate changes, I'll let you know.
The more Crystals people buy, the higher their price is. And vice versa.
First, choose if you are selling or buying. Enter the required amount, and I will tell you the price in gold.
If exchange rates changed while we were bargaining, I will freeze the deal and tell you the new rate. You will be able to decide if the new rate suits you or not.

r194844.n: Items that can be received for Symbols of Blood

t:
wants a good fight at the arena? You think you're so cool? We'll see that!

Go to the Battlegrounds and show what you're made of!

This is an excellent opportunity to earn glory, honors, and respect, and to acquire unique equipment and other valuable items. There are two teams fighting in a Skirmish. The idea is to find out who's the best, who's the strongest. There are no friends or allies. An Imperial team may face another Imperial team, League may fight League.

There are several arenas, each giving you the Signs of Victory. Use these signs to obtain Battleground Emblems and trade them for various prizes!
Do you want to confront other heroes in a fair combat? Welcome to the Battleground!

Grokh shagrak! I wish Agrus knew... He will burn you!
I find Orb. You save me before. I must give it to you.
r195017.n: Tell him that you have lost the Orb of Power

t:
While the Elves do not have the same problems as the Gibberlings and Orcs, they also have reasons to be unhappy with the League. The war, and especially the war as it was on Dane, is very far from the ideals of Beauty and Pleasure. Irretrievable losses, when the dead did not even have a chance to be reborn, horrified the Elves. "The league was created for safety, but what did we get besides endless battles?" This is what the few supporters of isolation have been saying so far.

That is why the new ruler of the Elves Antoinette de Delice negotiated with Yasker about developing stronger peaceful relations. Yasker agreed with her initiatives and announced the beginning of a "policy of detente" accompanied by "new thinking" - meaning the understanding that the conflict between the League and the Empire can be resolved peacefully. A cultural exchange has been organized - the youth of the League can visit the allods of the Empire, and vice versa!

Yes, it's a disaster. The forests are now filled with insane Treants, unusually overgrown plants, crystals, and Ambrosia streams that can harm travelers.

I suspect it's caused by the imprisonment of the Goddess of Nature in our world. Trapped by darkness, she spawns these... nightmares that break into the real world.

Nobody knows what to do with the shadow woods. They keep growing, absorbing more and more new territories.
r195103.n: Yes, it's a disaster. The forests are now filled with insane Treants,…

t:
Айденус и Яскер – два лидера государств в сложной ситуации. Они уже давно не контролируют происходящее в Сарнауте, и всё, что они могут сделать – это реагировать на новую угрозу. События на Джигране в очередной раз перевернули всё с ног на голову. И если для Айденуса возвращение Скракана - безусловное подспорье, то для Яскера – возвращение Незеба это опасный вызов и потенциальный кризис! Кто знает, не развернётся ли в Империи междуусобная борьба?

Впрочем, пока оба лидера контролируют происходящее. Все-таки они теперь не обязаны подчиняться Иркалле, которой пришлось убрать своих тёмных миньонов из столиц, да и общая угроза Тэпа пока работает на сплочение. Однако, кто знает, как дальше всё повернётся?
r195138.n: Айденус и Яскер – два лидера государств в сложной ситуации. Они уже…

t: Here, take it. This is all equipment you need, adjusted to your size and level.
r195190.n: Ask for a starter's equipment set

t:
"Oh spirits, I don't know what to say! Some places and events just change your very being in an instant! The Observatory took my breath away.

I learned a lot. They told me about other worlds, about Architects and time travel, about the endless Astral. News like this take time to digest.

It will take even longer to see it all!

Whoever is reading this note, I'll say goodbye. I don't know where I'm going, but it's somewhere far away. I'm looking for... I don't know what, but I must find it.

Go your own way. I'm sure it will be legendary. If you want it, of course.

I left a gift for my reader. Find the small crate. It contains the most valuable thing.

Take it with you. In a way, I'm grateful. It was a journey that we took together.

Good luck, whoever you are."
r195199.n: "Oh spirits, I don't know what to say! Some places and events just…

t:
"Yay, I was the best! ...in kicking down the obstacles. No surprise. It's made for the two-legged.

 I rushed towards the end, kicking down every obstacle in my way. I was so angry! Tried to be careful, of course - I didn't want to hurt anyone.

It's a good thing I was running behind everyone else. They were waiting for me at the finish line to let me cross it first as a sign of respect. No way, I thought. So I pushed the well-mannered Aoidoi beyond the finish line by force! They deserved this victory, so let them take it!

I'll balance the loss at the race. That's where I'll finish first!"

I wasn't first, of course. But the fourth place is an excellent result for a novice.

I even contemplated becoming a regular participant. It gives you a truly unique sensation: wind in the face and speed, just like on a hunt, but you run faster and don't have to kill anyone. However, it's nonsense. I know I'll get bored soon. But it's worth trying.

I've got this idea of a race where everyone bumps into one another until the strongest and the most skillful remains. I wonder if anything like this exists in the world?

Observatory is my destination now. I heard a lot about it while studying the local landmarks. They say it has a lot of smart guys who will surely advise me what else I should visit."
r195200.n: "Yay, I was the best! ...in kicking down the obstacles. No surprise.…

t:
"It's so much fun! Pegasus flights, ball throwing, the crowd cheering... The applause, I was told, is when all people start clapping their hands. I tried that with my hooves. I think it made me deaf in my right ear!

It doesn't matter what they tell me - I must try it myself. I can't wait, my hooves are shaking. I'm going to do it. No matter what. Everyone should! My next stop is Pegasus's back. End of story."

My request to participate made the jaws drop. They tried to talk me out of it, but their leader decided that a Centaur riding a Pegasus would be great publicity. He gave me the most powerful stallion!

Now picture their faces when I took out a piece of parchment and started scribbling - right there, in the air, on the Pegasus's back! As if I were an incredible poet of ancient times! That's what I'm doing right now. The parchment crackles and leaps out of my hands. There's too much magic here! I don't know if I can hold it. Gotta go somewhere quiet after the flight. Like the local maze where you can easily get lost..."

"I can't quite figure out where I am. All turns look the same. Here's a gazebo, and there's another one. I sat down to collect my thoughts while I'm writing another note.

After my spectacular ride, they allowed me to take part in other activities. I'm a local star - or, maybe, a local crazy. Go figure!

This place is... Creepy. Not only paths, but thoughts get twisted here. Someone evil created this place. Someone who enjoys watching people wander helplessly. Why on earth did I come here? And these Minotaurs... are staring. Some would say we're alike, but it's hard to imagine two more different species if you ask me. Don't even argue with that!

I must choose something simpler next time. An obstacle course, for example. The whole point is to get to the finish line first. Unsophisticated but still fun!

Now I should find a way out. If all else fails, they should remember about me and get me out of here... I hope."
r195201.n: "It's so much fun! Pegasus flights, ball throwing, the crowd…

t:
"It turns out I'm fond of villages, no matter who lives there (unless it's someone who wants to rip out your guts). They all look alike in a way. Whatever happens in the world, they live their own lives, look after their households, be it centaurs or humans...

I'm getting more and more romantic. I wonder if the travels awoke that in me, or if it's something all adventurers suffer from. I neither can nor want to figure it out! I think I'll just go with the flow.

I've been dreaming about lying alone in a pasture, far away from home, without knowing what lies ahead, simply admiring the stars. It's time to make the dream come true. Let me find the nearest pasture and head there."

"So I've been watching the sunset. I'm writing this note while the sun is still up, so I wouldn't ruin a starry night by scribbling things down.

Whenever the stars are visible, I don't feel like writing. They make you feel so small and unimportant... You start thinking about what's happening up there, the amazing and significant events.

I'm feeling nostalgic. I suddenly remembered my sis and my dear village. How are they doing back home? I'm not homesick, not really. But it'd be nice to know that they are doing fine.

Back to real life tomorrow. I'm taking part in all kinds of local entertainment - as a spectator first. I'm going to Coliseum in the morning. In the meantime..."
r195202.n: "It turns out I'm fond of villages, no matter who lives there (unless…

t:
"All right, the swords here aren't always clashing. I didn't see a single battle while I was here. I guess I was incredibly lucky.

Boy, did we get drunk! I had no idea so many people can ride my back all at once! An idea of giving people rides never occurred to me in the first place.

I received a mug with my name on it - somebody carved it with a knife. I was called "a great man and an average horse". They also invited me to stop by whenever I'm around. I will stop by on my way back, perhaps.

They say alcohol won't solve your problems. It sure won't, but a good party can chase away the gloom. It's important to maintain the balance... It's very important.

I'm going to the Dionic Archipelago. I've heard a lot of wonderful things about it. I'll see you on the docks, my imaginable follower."

"The docks don't seem extraordinary after you've seen Polis. Just barrels and crates... The flight was something to remember, though. I've never... flown? or sailed? Never traveled much. Anyway, seeing it is worth a thousand words.

I found a way to entertain myself, though. I assumed an air of importance and started walking around, opening boxes and barrels, examining their contents. People regarded me with suspicion, but no one dared to approach me. I looked very confident and somewhat menacing. I took nothing, though. I was just curious. Only one thing looked interesting: a sphere made of a semi-transparent gemstone, with fine dust whirling and glowing inside...

It's getting dark. The dockers told me there was a village not too far away. I'll spend the night and hit the road in the morning."
r195203.n: "All right, the swords here aren't always clashing. I didn't see a…

t:
"I think I know what Aoidos meant by "energies". We'd say this place was blessed by the spirits. They might have over-blessed it a bit. Everything here seems ordinary and miraculous at the same time.

The most interesting places are never talked about. You only get to learn about them by chance: overhear a conversation or see a turn in the road... I'm getting more and more confident that I made the right decision. You can't just sit around peacefully when there's a big world outside with so much to see!

I hope some other strange adventurer who finds my notes and follows my tracks will never regret their decision!

I discovered that I left my favorite toy behind. It's not that important, but it holds so many good memories. I'll drop by our camp tonight. Just need to make sure not to run into my sister or friends."

Just think about it. No two-legged creature can imagine how hard it is to sneak quietly on four muscular legs.

I got carried away and walked through the whole the camp! I can't brag about it to anyone, but it's something I can write down in my notes!

Familiar places look different at night. You get to notice things you never noticed before. It makes you understand things you couldn't until now. But enough of "philosophizing", as Aoidos used to say.

My sister was asleep as I grabbed the toy. I think she sensed my presence but never woke up. I don't know how. She might have sighed in a special way. I grew up with her, so I can feel her with my heart.

I know she will forgive me. She won't think I ran away.

There's only one place left to visit. It's the Site of Power. They say that the swords are always clashing there. I'll go to the champions' camp and get drunk to leave these lands without a second thought."
r195204.n: "I think I know what Aoidos meant by "energies". We'd say this place…

t:
"I'm sorry to leave you, my friend, but the road's a-callin'.

Besides, even if I stay, can a centaur find a job in Polis? This is how it is...

You've helped me realize something. If you keep searching, you'll eventually find something. I didn't know that at first, but then I understood. You just have a goal and strive to reach it. It doesn't matter what other people think. It requires strong will. Above all, don't lose yourself trying to solve another mystery!

Perhaps our paths will cross later. If you're interested, I'm heading to the South of Dion Mountain Range, beyond the Pearl Slopes, to see those demons people keep talking about."

"Demons are truly amazing creatures. I didn't expect them to look like that. And they communicate with the help of images they conjure up in your mind. Marvelous! It's strange that many consider them evil and dark creatures. Of course, they can be frightening. And they don't really understand humor. But they are so beautiful!

People despise rats as well, but have rats ever hurt anyone? They're living beings who want their share of food and water! Hardly any rat ever crawled inside a house with malicious intent!

Some demons never heard of centaurs, so I left a note to the most curious of them. He gave me something in return...

This is a lovely place. I'll sleep here, and then I'll head to Triquetrum. The Aoidos mentioned some kind of "energies" there. I need to see them."
r195205.n: "I'm sorry to leave you, my friend, but the road's a-callin'. Besides,…

t:
"Oh spirits, I have the strangest feeling. It's like guilt for being alive when Aellona is dead. Enough of being sad, though. I should leave a note in a safe place, away from prying eyes...

I'm asking myself why I'm doing this. Do I want to leave a trail? Do I secretly hope that someone might follow my tracks? Do I expect someone to find me? My sister, a secret admirer, or just someone simply wandering around the world?

Since I started making notes, I should continue. Now I'm wondering where it will take me!

It cheered me up. Where will I go next? I think I'll visit Polis. It isn't far from here. I heard it was a lovely place full of people. Maybe I can find a friend there."

"I didn't expect Polis to be such an amazing place. Aoidos managed to build so many things here. What a gifted nation! Just like us.

I came across a weird vagabond who was looking for something, mumbling nonsense. I tried to run away, but he just wouldn't leave me alone! One thing led to another, and here we are, relaxing after exploring this city's every nook and cranny. To understand how much fun we had, just imagine how hard it is for a CENTAUR to climb onto a roof. I'm not sure I can repeat that!

My friend loves secrecy and conspiracies! Poor fellow, he just can't see past these mysteries. I should remember to leave him a note about my future plans. It should make him happy."
r195206.n: "Oh spirits, I have the strangest feeling. It's like guilt for being…

t:
"I don't see why people love this Well so much. The morning sun is a thousand times more beautiful, and you can see it from everywhere.

I'm a simple centaur. I'm not even a shaman who talks to spirits. I can't see the whole picture. Come to think of it, why is it even called a "well"? It's no good for collecting water. Oh heavens, it is a weird place, indeed.

While I was grabbing a bite, I overheard a conversation. They were talking about Demon Hunters whose camp they liberated from demons a while ago. They're so brave! They fly through astral and hunt astral monsters there. They've been everywhere. I decided I should pay them a visit and listen to their stories. I hear nature is very beautiful there.

My hooves are aching, but adventure is calling! No time for rest!"

"I was too arrogant to ignore my aches... I hit my head on a branch and twisted two ankles! Thank the spirits it happened near the camp. The locals helped me and gave me food and water. They also told me a lot of stories. It almost feels like home.

I didn't leave home just to settle down somewhere else, even in a nice place like this. I looked at the sky and felt that my heart was full. The open road is calling my name again. Where should I head? I remembered the story of Kyros and Aellona. Kyros, the poor fellow, defeated our chief and earned the tribe's respect... After Aellona died, he went mad and messed up everything. Such a sad story, but also beautiful. I could write a song about it.

I decided to visit Aellona's grave. I'll leave in the morning."
r195207.n: "I don't see why people love this Well so much. The morning sun is a…

t:
... It is an old letter, scribbled on a piece of parchment, or rather, on a piece of rough leather.

Nevertheless, you can recognize the Aoidos language, written by a strong hand not used to writing.

"My dear sister! The wind and the road are calling me. I can't believe this day has come, but I'll be on my way tomorrow. I've always been a strange centaur. Our village is too small for me. I made up my mind. I want to travel, visit places, see the miracles and wonders of the world. Who knows, we might meet again some day. For what it's worth, don't be sad. I'd suffer here if I stayed.

P.S.: Don't worry about me, I'm not careless. I prepared for the long journey!

Here's my checklist:

An extra four of boots;

A bundle of food I picked up in the camp (no idea how long it will keep, though);

An axe. What would I be without it?

My favorite toy centaur (mini me);

A bunch of stuff for the road.

If you wonder where I'll go first, it's the Well of Souls. They say it's the most amazing place on Ammer! I don't know what it is, but that makes it better! Maybe I'll write a song.

Alright, it's taking too long. I'm going to bed, I've got an early morning tomorrow."
r195208.n: Ask to see the historical document

t: Very interesting story. One centaur huntress received a note from her missing brother. She was very worried about him and asked you to look for him. You had to follow his trail and find the notes he left behind. I can show them to you if you're interested.
r195209.n: Ask about the notes of Centaur the Traveler

t: That's how the story of the June heroes ended. Klavdia Kalugina took the Sparks of Ath-Zak, Luja-Gialla, and Tka-Rik. She probably still has them.

I believe these documents prove a lot. But my story of your deeds will not be complete without the description of the final meeting with Nihaz. You found the Sparks of three June heroes, after all.

"Hahaha! You really thought I was hiding the Sparks? Or giving them to someone else? Come on now, it isn't our first game. How could you be so naive?

If I simply wanted to destroy you, why would I waste so much time? Are you really that stupid to think that your actions have no consequences?

I hope you've seen and learned enough. The Junes. The Zem. They've made their choices. Who should they blame but themselves if the choice is wrong? Do you understand now? Perhaps there is still hope for you?

But that's enough. Let's see who wins the bet, shall we?

Ah! You managed to break the rules in a game that only had two rules!

NO help AT ALL! All you did was ask around for help!

Everybody must face the consequences of their foolishness...

Then Klavdia Kalugina intervened, showing up out of the blue.

"Oh, come on. Everyone knows that this bet was null and void from the start. Your tasks are impossible to complete."

"Nevertheless, shehe agreed."

"We don't need to stoop to such trickery! I know you agree with me.

I'm going to pull my rank to declare it void and confiscate everything that was found during the bet.

Especially since none of you have the slightest idea what to do with the Sparks.

Keep on playing your games. Oh, and before you find your tongues... Bye-bye, Daddy and you, hero.

Well, then... I guess we are both left in the dust. My daughter is something else. Come here.

Haha, isn't my daughter clever?

I hope you understand the reason behind all this.

Anyway, I think you've found everything you were looking for. And I'm going to give you a consolation prize, of course.

You can go now. It's time for me to get back to business... In the tavern.
r195211.n: I believe these documents prove a lot. But my story of your deeds will…

t:
You're tired of reading, but you turn the page. It's "Thibault de Desirae's thoughts on some paradoxes on the Coba Plateau". Here's a fragment:

The story that happened here, on Coba Plateau, still haunts me. When Tep was constructing the pyramids, preparing to destroy his people, this place was the center of his cult.

Contrary to popular belief, the greatest battle between him and the Zem Mechanics took place here, in a place now known as Spectral Gorge. That's where the pyramid with a destroyed top is.

My expedition conducted research and established some facts that contradict the popular interpretation of the story.

First of all, there's the question: who buried Nefer Ur and other mechanics on Hickut (now known as Xadagan), even though they died here, on Coba Plateau?

We also failed to find residual plague in soil and water, even though everything here should still be dead.

Here is an interesting fact learned by my colleague Noel de Blizare from legends of local people now living in the Holy Land.

According to them, death came here. It breathed its black breath, and life itself writhed in agony. Just when there seemed to be no hope, a beautiful girl, a great sorceress, came here. Morning glory flowers grew in her footsteps as she walked. With her power she destroyed death and left no trace. It took her a while to bury all the dead people. She sealed the eternally dying Tep in his main Pyramid known as Asee-Teph.

Who could that be? A Great Mage from the past? An unknown goddess? I'm afraid we'll never know the answers. Maybe Zayan knows something?
r195212.n: You're tired of reading, but you turn the page. It's "Thibault de…

t:
You're reading another page from the folder. "Sarang Petosiris, Tep Cultist's speech". Here's a fragment:

Tep? How dare you say this name?!

Tep is the greatest necromancer of our world! In my past life, I was honored to help him! Tep was studying June magic then.
Junes... Oh yes, they achieved so much. So, Tep studied them. His primary field was blood magic. The Junes knew a thing or two about it. Blood has great power. It has the life power of the Spark. By consuming blood, you consume someone else's power. Why do you think the Great Mages drink dragon blood? Or the Demonologists drink demon blood? Or vampires!

Tep went even further. June magic didn't help them when the Curse appeared... the first demon.

Yes, that's right. The legendary June Curse was a demon. You didn't know? That's weird. I've seen it as clearly as I see you. And you might see it some day! Why? What do you mean - why? It's there somewhere. What did it look like? The last time I saw it, it was following the real Junes. They're extinct now, of course. But there are so many people with June blood in their veins! Why do you think the astral demons look so much like the Curse? It's out there! I can't believe you live in this world and know so little about it.

Tep now consumed Sparks instead of blood. A straightforward way is always faster. But he needed a stock. A stock of Sparks. It wouldn't have worked if Tep hadn't found a record about the Box. Nih's box, of course.

Basically, this world is a trap for Sparks. Nothing can leave it. Tep found the source of the power that's holding it inside without letting anything out. How? I don't know.

Based on this power, he built pyramids. He also created the Plague. You'll have a taste of it when Tep comes back...

Ouch, don't hit me!

The note stops abruptly.

t:
"You're reading another page from the folder. "Joint report of Nomarkhs Semerkhet, Yasskul Khufukhaf, and Taltal: the Holy Lands research." Here's a fragment:

The conclusions based on the results of our research are fully consistent with our preliminary assessment stated during the historical conference "The June impact on Zem culture."

The following has been proven:

1. There was a large-scale cultural influence expressed in the need to conduct a ritual, during which each of the Zem was required to visit the territories of the former June state and inspect the ruins in order to strengthen motivation in the search for immortality. This fact is confirmed both by the testimonies of witnesses (including the authors of the report) and by the numerous traces of Zem presence on Asee-Teph.

2. Proven fact: a journey of a famous Zem known as Tep took place around 2470 AD (Old Era).

3. The study of the structure known as "Tensess Temple" has provided evidence that the journey made a significant impact on the individual's personality and mind.

4. It has been established that soon after the journey, Tep discovered the nature of Sparks and began a large-scale construction of Spark storage facilities also known as "Tep's Pyramids".

Conclusions:

With a high degree of probability, we conclude that Tep's journey to the ruins of the June civilization helped inspire his scientific breakthrough involving the discovery of Sparks and Immortality. We leave speculations on the nature of knowledge (in particular, the marginal theory that the god of Death appeared before Tep and personally granted him the knowledge) to the readers."
r195214.n: "You're reading another page from the folder. "Joint report of…

t:
"You're reading another page from the folder. "A letter from Yaver Amenia, Evette de Doucer, and Antoinette de Grandeur to the Council of Historians on allod Neigh." Here's a fragment:

Dear colleagues, we have completed the study of the June ruins on Eljune. In the course of our research, we reconstructed the history of this location.

June Itsmal was one of the largest June cities. Located in the bay, it had an exit to the open sea and the ocean surrounding Yule. This made it a major trade port. The city comprised not only the immediate area of today's June Itsmal, but also the vast area from the Jakala Ruins to the Icemirror Lake.

Goods from all over the world were brought to the city. There is evidence that trade was conducted with Tekyan people from Irdrich and with a mysterious "fifth human tribe".

The city sustained serious damage during the dragon war. On numerous occasions it was burned almost to the ground but was rebuilt every time.
The fatal blow was dealt when the June Curse came here. Research proves that it is the original form of astral demons, endowed with extraordinary power.

Most citizens died; the rest were able to escape through portals. The final wave of survivors were saved by a miracle. We may safely say that the Junes elected to split into small groups and spread out across the continent. This allowed them to avoid the Curse for a long time. However, this also led to a gradual cultural regression and assimilation.

Wormfaces later visited the ruins. Perhaps they became sacred locations for former Junes who remember the past."
r195215.n: "You're reading another page from the folder. "A letter from Yaver…

t:
"You're reading another page from the folder. It's titled "Noel de Blizare's Journal". Here's a fragment:

I never regretted going on this expedition!

It's what my teacher, the famous naturalist Alphonse de Ardeur, would have wanted.

The Holy Lands are full of various life forms. I talked to almost all of them! It makes you think: what could one discuss with a troll? How to approach a Mantis? What could Harpies tell you?

I'll tell you - there's a way to everyone's heart. For instance, I talked to ogres. They are considered rude and cruel, and unjustly so! There's beauty in everyone. It may be too deep, But it's important to find the right words.

I managed. It turns out, the poor primitive minds can easily be influenced, if you just keep talking... But not everyone is capable of it. I'm remembering poor Adele de Grandeur... She had a brilliant mind and several PhDs, but she faltered and stammered... and became an ogre's meal.

What's also important is these people are preserving their history. They write songs and poems, carve pictures on bones. I've learned a lot. The ancient legends from the June times, stories about wars of the past...

The Junes were belligerent. With the education they received from our Elven ancestors, they became a truly fearsome power. They built Paths that allowed them to navigate the portal network. We've only recently started to figure them out! Not to mention golems, both small and big as a mountain!

Lamias, for example, remember the June wars very well. Alphonse was right about them. Lamias worshipped a snake goddess. Junes found her and slayed her. Fancy that - they killed a real albeit minor deity! No wonder the dragons weren't a problem for them.

I'm sending my notes to Bertille de Pluie. She's smart - maybe she could put them all together in a book.

Bertille's handwritten note: "Someone explain to this fool that "personal contact" does not mean what she thinks it means."

t:
Here are some interesting documents you found on a pirate ship:

"You're reading a page from the folder. It's titled, "Marianna Lopatina's Log, August 13, 1018"

This is the last page of my log. Goblins stole the other pages. There's something wrong in the Holy Lands. Now I'm thinking about coincidences. The legend of Ath-Zak is called "Cursed Lands".

Are the Holy and the Cursed Lands all that different? When the world wasn't split apart, it took only a few days to get from Gipat to Eljune.

Now it's time to sum up my travel. Junes' fate is clear. They fell under the Curse that has been hunting for the Junes. They separated. Some of them became Wormfaces, others managed to escape.

The outcasts are now condemned to misery. I spoke with a Tep's Cultist. He was kind enough to share some information after I threatened to blast him apart.

Tep took great interest in the Junes' legacy. He and his servants met the Junes who escaped from the Curse. There were rumors about a city in the mountains under a spell so powerful that it drove the Curse away.

This city was where Gipat is now. Was it Tka-Rik's farewell gift? We can only guess the future. Hundreds of years later, the Aro tribes came to these lands. They formed an alliance with the June descendants which gave the world many talented creators.

My readers probably have already guessed what it is. Today it is known as the Dead City. Nothing lasts forever. The Curse was destined to find June descendants sooner or later. Some of them escaped again. More Kanians than Junes, they now live in the Village.

When Zak came to the Village, he found his distant relatives. Is this Fate mocking us? It's up to you to decide.

I'm going on a new expedition. I want to find out if Jigran is a legend or reality."
r195217.n: Here are some interesting documents you found on a pirate ship:…

t:
So here are the visions you had near the stone arch:

"Everything is so hazy... You see a different place... but you realize that it's the Coba Plateau, only thousands of years ago. You see a thin man in white robes. Only his amber eyes can be seen under the mask. He leans over a June stele to read the text on it. He's silent and thoughtful.

You hear someone calling "Tep!", and the man turns around."

"Everything is blurry and sparkly. You can see consequences of a terrible war that happened in this land. Traces of battles, dead bodies... no living thing dares to approach the bodies. There are no vultures or scavengers here. The "non-life" seems to be caused by an unknown disease that killed everything.

Suddenly you see a girl with light ginger hair and delicate features. She walks between the bodies. Waves of the black disease are rolling away from her.

"You can do it," she says to herself and raises her hands to cast a powerful spell. "You are the soul of the world."

t:
You had to find the last Spark that belonged to Ath-Zak. This is how Nihaz instructed you before you left for the Coba Plateau:

"The time has come for our final game in these lands.

If you only knew how hard it is to stage Performances for you! Actors never stick to the script, prop masters damage the props...

I had to put in a lot of effort to stage a small Performance for someone whose Spark you're going to be looking for. Starting a rumor on Suslanger that there are meteorites in the Futile Lands... Whispering to Kanian descendants on Gipat that the Chosen One will appear in the old ruins. And finally, send the weakened Curse after the last Junes...

Ath-Zak's Spark wasn't all that valuable for me after all. A crafty thief once stole it. I won't tell you when it happened or who he was, but here's a generous hint. This is a fragment of the letter he wrote when he left for the Coba Plateau..."

I won't describe your pursuit of one unlucky Gibberling. I will only tell you about some of the visions you had, and will attach the relevant documents.
r195219.n: You had to find the last Spark that belonged to Ath-Zak. This is how…

t:
Nihaz summed it up in the end:

"Hah, I hope you realize now that the Junes' fate was their own fault?

Their success depended on the dragon blood, the borrowed power that failed to help them against the Curse of their own Creator.

The Great Mage Tka-Rik? What a whiner. After everything that happened to the Junes, he blamed himself, felt remorse, and condemned himself to centuries of imprisonment under Gipat mountains. But his legacy survived. The elves have awakened to find a lot of Junes' artifacts, including those of blood magic. It ended badly for them. With time, they hit upon the idea of trying dragon blood.

This is how they got their own Great Mages, who later trained Skrakan, who then trained the others, and finally, you all nearly destroyed the world by shattering it into pieces.

Thank Tka-Rik and his thirst for revenge for all this."
r195220.n: Nihaz summed it up in the end: "Hah, I hope you realize now that the…

t:
Further information was not preserved in written form, but you received a vision that allowed you to learn about the ending of the story.

"A kaleidoscope of images whirl through your mind as you touch this artifact: the Junes, fighting a thousand bloody battles with dragons. The losses on both sides are huge, but the hatred burns so hot that no one cares to stop. One after another, the Great Dragons, Keepers of the Prison, fall before the growing power. The first among the dragon hunters is Tka-Rik, the greatest mage that Sarnaut has ever seen.

Finally, eight of the Great Dragons are dead. There's only one left. He's hiding in the mountains like a coward. It won't be long until he's killed, and the Junes fulfill their pledge. But the night comes when the darkness thickens and turns into a monster that has no name. The dismayed Junes face it in the ancient city near the source of celestial iron."

One more translation of another part of this story:

"And then the Dark One, as the Junes call him, spoke to them:

He said, "Oh, the Junes! Sarn told you to kill all dragons. Did he tell you what awaits you afterwards?"

The Junes were confused. They didn't know how to reply.

"You see, the very second you kill the last dragon, this world will cease to exist. Of course, Sarn will be set free. But you all are going to die!"

The Junes then asked what the Dark One was suggesting.

"I will give you the choice that Sarn didn't offer you. You may choose to keep the promise you gave Sarn, and die together with Sarnaut. Or you could forget about the dragon hunt!"

The Junes then asked if Nihaz could protect them from Sarn's wrath.

"I don't fear Sarn! Behold the Star Gates through which I travel between the worlds... Should there be danger, I will give you a new world, and you'll be your own masters!"
The Junes then renounced their promise. They gave their answer to the Dark One in the place where the magic power of the world spilled and transformed into thousands of elementals. This is where the June Curse was born!"

t:
This is how the story continued:

"The wind howls among the rocks. A fire dragon is flying in the sky. There's fire in her eyes, flame in her jaws. Sharp eyes are watching her every move. The Junes are at the ready. A lot of Dragon Hunters have been trained over these years.

Can anything pierce through the scales that are tougher than stone? Can anything compare to the wings that cover the sky? Is there a fire hotter than the dragon flame?

Only time will tell. War golems roar. Ballistae are sending arrows in the sky, one after another. The dragon is furious. She's on a rampage. She breathes fire. Mages enter the battle. Tka-a-Lithan Ric-ti-a-Nic is in the vanguard.

This time, it's happening! People are stronger than the fire dragons. The dragon cannot believe she is defeated. She hits the ground. Her wounds are bleeding. Hunters rush toward the dragon. Their spears are forged from celestial iron, they glitter in the sun.

What to expect from this fight? The monster is dangerous even on the ground. Skik-a-Sbal Ici-ti-a-Kimi is there first. She dodges the gigantic paws and tail that swing and strike the people. The dragon is furious. Rivers of flame burn down dozens of hunters.

The battle rages on... The fire dragon is in agony. Mages hit her with lightning bolts, golems shower her with stones, and the first among Hunters finally drives her spear into a flaming eye. And the dragon's final blast hits her.

Is there need to mention what happens next? The Junes are happy. Dead body of their eternal enemy lies in front of them. The Junes are also grieving. Many lives ended on this day. Tka-a-Lithan Ric-ti-a-Nic is on his knees... he has lost his love."

"You've taken my heart. I'll take yours," Tka-a-Lithan Ric-ti-a-Nic says as he draws an obsidian blade.

The bleeding dragon's heart is delivered to the Main Temple. Dragon blood is running like an endless stream. Greatest heroes of the Junes pass a goblet full of dragon blood. They drink without knowing that blood endows them with strength, longevity, and eternal thirst for dragon blood...

What happened that night? The Junes go out to the terrace to see a creature of an amazing beauty, shining like the sun of God... One after another, they kneel before him.

"I am your Creator. My name is Sarn," his voice thunders. "My children, you have done an extraordinary thing! The enemy put me in chains. Today you broke one of the chains. You are the chosen ones. You're the embodiment of my intention. You have my blessing. Your goal is to destroy all the dragons, find each of the cursed monsters, and exterminate their kin without pity. You can do it! And then... I will be free."

Inspired by the Creator's blessing, the Junes swore loyalty to him. Now the dragons will taste their fury! Incinerated cities and dead people will be avenged! Junes will forever chase the dragons - to the edge of the world!

t:
The search led you to new information from the June tablets:

The tablet translation goes:

"The young man and the girl called the ruler for action. How could anyone put up with the fire dragon's attacks?

But the wise ruler Witzliwitle laughed and said,

"You may be brave, but you're stupid. A man is weak. A man can never fight a mighty fire dragon!"

But the young man and the girl protested, asking him to avenge the destroyed cities and the dead people.

Witzliwitle said,

"Prove your bravery! Go to the mountain where the leader of all tigers lives! Each of these leaders is named after Shere Khin. Fight him. Defeat him. Bring me his skin. Prove your courage! When you do, your names shall remain in history forever."

Defeating the great tiger wasn't easy, but the young man and the girl were skilled and crafty enough. The Miktlan ruler Witzliwitle stood up and said,

"Say your names!"

"I'm Tka-a-Lithan Ric-ti-a-Nic," the man said.

"I'm Skik-a-Sbal Ici-ti-a-Kimi," the girl said.

And the Miktlan ruler sent the brave girl and the brave man to the Junes' greatest teachers, Shilonen, Coatl, and Atslan. Shilonen once was a sage and a philosopher. Coatl was a great magician. Atslan was a skilled warrior. The three teachers taught them everything they knew. The smart Tka-a-Lithan Ric-ti-a-Nic has become the greatest mage, ruling the elements. The strong Skik-a-Sbal Ici-ti-a-Kimi has become the strongest warrior, so swift and agile that no one could make out her moves.

The Junes' power grew. Ten years after the young man and the girl appeared they decided to challenge the dragons.

t:
In the course of a long search, you managed to find the beginning of this story:

The elven instructions allow you to decipher the June tablet:

"Once there was a young man. He lived in a village. Like all men of his age, he liked girls. There was a girl from the neighboring village that he was seeing at nights.

The night was quiet, only maize was rustling under the moon, and a cowardly ocelot was sneaking along the creek. The young man and the girl were in love. Nothing could keep them apart that night.

But a wind suddenly arose. It was violent like a hurricane! It bent century-old trees and ripped shingles from roofs. That was an unusual wind.

The young man peered into darkness. Suddenly, a bright light appeared, as if the sun came up. Those were the flames breathed out by a horrendous fire dragon. Both villages turned to ash in a heartbeat. The fire dragon disappeared.

When the real sun came up, the young man and the girl left the smoldering ruins. The road to the nearest city passed through the dryland. To the city of Uskul."

The Quartermaster left you a brief translation of the June tablet.
"The young man and the girl were walking through deserted lands and barrens for a long time. They were headed to the June cities far away from their village. The road was hard. They had to survive on cactus fruit. They came across a cunning jackal, a poisonous snake, and a vampire bat. But they defeated all of them with their skills.

They arrived at the city and started looking for help to get revenge. However, no one was willing to fight gigantic fire dragons. People only cared about their own lives. Finally, they arrived at the remote city on the edge of the great forest.

"Our building will never turn to dust," the ruler of the city said. "We have a lot of shelters and places to hide. The rocks will help see the hidden ways."

t:
You had a new journey ahead, to Asee-Teph where Tka-Rik's Spark was hidden. Nihaz talked about it:

"Tka-Rik, or Tka-a-Lithan Ric-ti-a-Nic, the greatest June mage, first of the Great Mages...

His Revelation was interesting, wasn't it? How did you like learning the mysteries of the world? Oh, I put a lot of effort into staging the Performance to open your eyes to Sarn's lies.

The Great Mage found his death in his cave. He fell to Sarn's demons' hands on the night that you refer to as the Night of Astral Portals. It's only the end of his story. How did it begin?

Let's remember the dragons. The guards of Sarn's prison, watching him at my behest. Dragons are obedient. Time has no power over them. They were fulfilling their duty for millions of years. But everything changed when a small ship carrying the Absolute Order got in trouble in the middle of nowhere.

The Ship falls on Sarnaut. It explodes in a dazzling flash somewhere high. Several dragons fall down, killed by shrapnel. The prison is breached. The prisoner makes a move.

He has a cunning plan, and it takes dragons a while to understand what's going on. Everything becomes clear when people come to this world. Dragons begin their war... the war to destroy all of Sarn's creations.

Do you want to know what happened next? Retrace the events of the ancient war. Explore Asee-Teph. Start from the place where rivers of blood flowed. This is where you can find a thread to pull and unravel the mystery."

t:
Nihaz summed it up in the end:

"You have found Luja-Gialla's Spark! Did you like the story? A real tragedy, isn't it?

Sarn created a number of races, trying to make ideal terminators. It was fun to ruin his plans! All it took was telling the Junes what they will face after the last dragon's death! Poor Sarn! He never expected them to renounce their vows! He cursed them in anger, and it was a very strong Curse. He regretted it later, of course, but I didn't let him interfere.

This is a truly beautiful story. Some of them give up their essence and stop being Junes. Others flee.

Tka-Rik really managed to hold off the Curse during that battle. He also cast the teleportation spell that saved the survivors from the Jakala Ruins. He didn't see them again for many years.

The runaways were hiding from the Curse, weakened by the battle, for centuries. From time to time it picked up their trail, killed some of them... but others managed to flee. Yes, Luja-Gialla and Ath-Zak are their descendants.

Do you wish to know how Tka-Rik came to be the Great Mage and the Bane of the Fire Dragons? That's a whole different story."

t:
Alas, Marianna’s further notes were apparently lost. However, the ghost of Luja-Gialla explained something when you met her:

"Who are you? Where's my beloved Ath-Zak?"

"Greetings, Luja-Gialla!"

"Stop! If you take one more step, I'll summon the Catacomb Masters! You'll die a terrible death!

…

No, wait... it was... so long ago.

Oh, my beloved Ath-Zak! What happened to us?"

"What do you remember?"

"Bits and pieces.

Zak saved me on Ignos... and then Zak turned out to be my beloved Ath-Zak. They defeated the Curse together with the wise Tka-Rik. I don't know what happened next. I only remember the darkness... and voices. Many voices. Moaning, crying, whispering..."

"What do you know about Tka-Rik?"

"Tka-Rik was one of the mages in an old book from my childhood. This mage is sleeping on a remote island, and when he wakes up, the good old times will return.

We're descendants of those who escaped from the June cities destroyed by the Curse. Now I know that Tka-Rik and I went our separate ways then. He opened a portal that took my people far away from these lands.

The reality became a story. The story became a legend."

"What do you think about Nihaz and his game?"

"Be very careful. Nihaz is treacherous. He never lies to you directly, but you shouldn't trust him. The Dark God enjoys playing with us, beckoning us with false hope.

You risked so much for us. I'm eternally grateful.

Remember! You'll only have one chance when the time comes."

"Let me take your Spark..."

"Take it. I know you can find Ath-Zak, wherever he is! I'll be waiting for us to be reunited, just like I waited back then..."

t:
So you managed to get important information from a participant in those events. But let's get back to Marianna's journal.

Marianna Lopatina's Log.

June 29, 1018

This is getting dangerous. Someone wants my journal. It's the goblins I escaped from. Now they're after me.

Fortunately, I found a network of demonic portals while trying to learn about the June history. Now I have time to decide where to go next.

We're aware that the Curse was, apparently, one of the first demons. Who could tell me about them? I need to find an expert...

Marianna Lopatina's Log.

July 1, 1018

I found a pilgrim who is also a Demon Hunter, among other things!

And I say, he's got a keen eye! He knows his way around demons like he has a nose for them.

The Hunter told me that he found ruins with traces of a demon so powerful that even an Octulhu would be like a kitten next to them. He said the battle between this demon and a mage had dented the earth. Over time, water accumulated there.

I wonder if I can find this place. My search might be coming to an end!

Marianna Lopatina's Log.

July 2, 1018

The water was freezing! It was a miracle that I didn't turn to ice in this cold water.

It's a good thing I bought the magimeter in the port. Without it, I wouldn't have found anything.

It's true. There was a battle where the lake is. The Curse has overcome the June survivors again. And the June mage had to fight him. His most powerful spells could only delay the enemy for a while.

The Curse was trapped in ice. Junes had only a few minutes. They ran... higher and higher.

The mage stayed behind to cast another spell.

t:
And here are the words of the June's Ghost which you saw during the ritual of the Forestfolk:

"Oh, naive people... Why do you do this dance?"

I'm not a Forestfolk!"

"[The spirit is looking at you in surprise]

You look like one... Well... What do you want from me, little non-Forestfolk?"

"Who are you?"

"I'm a June... or rather, I was once. Our people fell under the rage of our Creator's Curse. We ran, but the Curse followed us everywhere. I stayed to hold it off and let my family escape.

I just bought them some time. I hope it was enough for my family..."

"Why do Forestfolk worship you?"

"They just enjoy worshipping.

Did they tell you about the reason for our war?

The lesser people were the reason why the evil gods appeared. Those savages worshipped elementals. Two elementals, to be exact. They offered bloody sacrifice. The more they prayed, the stronger the wicked creatures became. This is how the two monsters came to life: Ayateotle, the master of frost, and Sheytekutli, the master of fire. They caused too much pain...

This is in the past now. I feel that you've found a cache with my story... or followed the footsteps of someone who found it. It doesn't matter. Now you know everything."

"What happened to the Junes next?"

"That I don't know.

Could you find out what happened to my family? Lua-Katley was my wife. We had two children, Tui-Yum and Lai-Kuwa.

I know that the Curse has been following the Junes around. I managed to hold it off by destroying the portal that the Curse created. Here's a fragment.

I don't quite understand what's going on in the world, but I think you can find the trail of the Curse. There should be a place out there that has a connection with the Curse... and the likes of it."

t:
Later you received a pipe and had the following conversation with the Forestfolk:

"Do you know what this reed pipe is for?"

"The pipe... Where did you get it? It's a secret!

Alright, I'll tell you, although we don't tell out secrets to strangers.

There's a legend that is passed from generation to generation.

A powerful race once lived here. You call this race the Junes.

Forestfolk were just a part of a large nation that united Waterfolk and Mountainfolk. We were proud and numerous. We occupied all land and wanted more. So we waged a war against the Junes!

Of course, they were much stronger. In the end, we lost. We suffered heavy losses, and the Junes chased us down to the edge of the land. We ran and scattered throughout the world..."

"How did you save yourself?"

"We begged the Junes for mercy!

And they spared our lives. They were at war with dragons now...

By that time, our nation has split. Those who could talk with trees became Forestfold. Those who speak with the river became Waterfolk, and Mountainfolk were the people of mountains.

June helped us like no one helped us before. And the day came when they needed our help!

Their people split as well. Some of them remained the June people and came to this village which has been on this river bank for thousands of years. Rumor has it, it was warmer before.

But their Curse was awake! It followed them. A June gave his life to protect his own kin and my tribe. We saved our lives while he stood in the Curse's way.

We have revered the hero ever since. Sometimes his spirit pays a visit."

t:
I decided to attach the recording of this conversation to the documents, since it's not irrelevant:

"Oh, wonderful song of the Astral... So peaceful! Can you hear it?"

"Do you remember your talk with Stoneroot? He told me that sometimes you can hear the Astral singing to you."

"Yes, I heard this voice before, during the Great Astral Campaign.

We were going to the demonic portal when we heard this song. Oh, Tensess, it was so beautiful! Tears came to our eyes as we listened... It was like a mother's song over the cradle... So sad... So touching... We heard it with out hearts!

It's a song about everything we lost.

I'm a hermit now. I came to Eljune, and heard this song again as I was walking along the shore.

Go... and listen! It's somewhere close by... It's wandering imperceptibly, and only those who can listen will hear it."

t:
Here I will have to insert your conversation with a wise Treant whose ancestor was supposedly a witness to the June dispute:

"Oh wise Treant, do you know about the Junes' decision, witnessed by the sky, water, and woods?"

Humm... Do you want to know the words, pronounced so long ago, shortling?

Aye, I do remember them... My grandfather's grandfather wasn't even a seed when the words were said... humm... We remember. We remember many things... humm...

The same year when the Darkness first came, people with the red bark were fighting in the ruined city...

Some of them decided to turn to the Dark One. They summoned him at night, begging, reminding him about the given promise... humm... The Dark One only laughed. He said that by the break of dawn the people with the red bark will be free from the Curse...

When the sun rose, they cried with horror. Those who rejected the Dark One's help looked at their kin and recoiled with disgust... humm...

Their appearance was horrendous. They weren't people anymore. They were beasts with tentacles on their faces. No longer the sun-loving Junes with red bark. They became cold and slimy creatures, fond of dump dungeons.

They had nothing in common. That was the Dark One's gift... humm..."

"What happened to those who rejected the Dark One's gift?"

"Humm...  There is no mention of it. The sky won't talk about it, the earth won't say it, the wind won't whisper in the leaves...

Unless the filth that's eating the earth talks. Someone once told me that sometimes it sings. Humm... I don't know his name, but this man's fate was bound to the Astral... Something happened to him out there, in the Astral... something very important. I'm sorry, that is all I know... humm...

If you find him, give him a piece of my bark. He should remember our conversation."

t:
Let's continue reading the journals...

I will omit the description of her adventures, since her actions often bring discredit to the profession of historian. She is always looking for trouble:

Marianna Lopatina's Log.

June 27, 1018

Ha, I knew the June city ruins are a real treasure with all their secrets! You'd think that over the years, the Historians would have taken everything. But after spending several minutes among the columns I found several caches!

Here's a brief translation of the June's journal.

"I'm so happy! I'm thanking the gods! I've found my family that I thought I'd lost forever!

I thought they were dead, my dear wife and children. But I found them among the smoldering ruins of June Itsmal! We all gathered here under the leadership of the brave Tka-a-Lithan Ric-ti-a-Nic to decide what to do next.

We have a near-even split. Some say we should run, others insist we should stay and talk to the Dark One. We have several days before the Curse comes back. For now, it's aiming at the other cities. Smoke is rising above our cities along the coast...

We must hurry and make up our minds. The skies, waters, and woods will witness our decision. Oh gods help us select the right path."

Curious... This looks like the last tablet from the ruins. Goblins must have taken the rest. I wonder where the next part of the story is. How can I know what the Junes decided it their only witnesses were "the skies, waters, and woods"?

Any other witnesses would have fled somewhere southeast, away from the darkness.

If only the trees could talk...
